_comment: The VIP group's record. Hand-maintained: these bets are advised in the VIP
group, not produced by the model, so nothing else can know about them.
months — the monthly point totals, as Dan keeps them. This is the history
from before we tracked individual bets, and it is what the graph plots. Any
month that also has bets listed below is recomputed from those bets instead,
so the graph and the list can never disagree.
bets — by month. Only the bet belongs here: the horse, what was staked, and
the price it was advised at. Course, off time, finishing position and the
each-way terms are all looked up from our own data by publish-vip.ts, so a
typo in a course name cannot put a bet in the wrong race and the terms on
the page can never disagree with the terms we hold.
type:  "win" or "ew". An each-way bet stakes twice the unit.
stake: points on the win part. 1 + "ew" is a 1pt each-way, 2pts total.
price: as advised, not the SP. null if it was not recorded.
position: OPTIONAL, and only to settle a race the feed has not published
yet — Dan watched it and the site should not sit on 'to run' for an
hour. The official result always wins once it arrives, so this never
needs removing and can never hold a wrong figure on the page.
Push it with:  npm run publish:vip -- 2026-10
